For your question about whether peak concentration needs are required for therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) of vancomycin, our retrieved matches suggest that this is not the case. According to the completion of the prompt "Is peak concentration needed in therapeutic drug monitoring of vancomycin?", these results indicate little need to use peak concentration in vancomycin TDM because Cmin/MIC and Cmin are sufficient to predict the efficacy and safety of vancomycin.

In summary, the available data do not support the necessity of using peak concentrations for vancomycin TDM. Instead, trough levels (Cmin) and minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) can accurately predict the effectiveness and potential risks associated with vancomycin therapy.
